queries_run: STMicroelectronics antitrust OR competition investigation OR regulatory scrutiny 2026

findings.claim: 20-F FY2025 將反壟斷、競爭法列為尚未演變成訴訟的法律風險；重大訴訟見 Note 26，未見反壟斷調查或拆分的專述。
findings.excerpt: We are also exposed to numerous legal risks which until now have not resulted in legal disputes and proceedings. These include risks related to product recalls, environment, shareholder rights, tariffs and export control regulations, anti-trust, anti-corruption, competition as well as other compliance regulations.

findings.claim: 產業監管：美國商務部依 232 條款對進口半導體啟動國安調查，可能帶來額外關稅與貿易限制。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 20-F FY2025 Item 3 Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: in April 2025, the Department of Commerce launched an investigation into the national security impacts of imported semiconductors and semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This investigation may result in additional tariffs and trade restrictions that may adversely impact the semiconductor industry and our business.

findings.claim: 網路搜尋未找到 2026 年針對 STM 的反壟斷調查；僅見 2008–2009 年歐盟智慧卡晶片卡特爾調查舊案。

regulatory_antitrust.note: 只下 1 次搜尋；搜尋未見 2026 年 DOJ/FTC/EU 對 STM 的反壟斷案。
